description: This file defines a function `displayIndicatorField` used to generate a display indicator for email records in the SuiteCRM (SugarCRM-based) system. It handles retrieving email bean data and rendering a Smarty template based on input parameters.

methods.name: displayIndicatorField
methods.description: Generates and returns an HTML snippet for an email indicator, using a Smarty template, based on provided focus data and view context.
